criteria.description: Every package is linked to an objective/AC (non-empty Objective enforced; >=1 AcceptedACID enforced; AC->package mapping exposed via PackageForAC).
An invalid DAG cannot be persisted as runnable (ValidatedWorkGraph only constructible through the validators; every negative path returns (nil, err)).
The graph is deterministic for an identical specification (Decompose is pure; MarshalWorkGraph canonicalises; byte-identical across re-decomposition).

evidence.reference: internal/workgraph.TestIntegration_CompileThenDecompose (real task.Compile output: every compiler-produced AC owned exactly once with non-empty objective)
internal/workgraph.TestIntegration_CompileVagueInputDecomposesSafely (LOW-confidence compiler output never yields an invalid runnable)

blackbox.scenario: M14-04 ships no production wiring (no daemon endpoint, no CLI command, no storage table, no scheduler hook) -- it is a pure domain library in internal/workgraph/. Per Engineering Baseline v1 section 3 rule 3, acceptance still requires a blackbox scenario with status=passed (no exemption at acceptance); the documented equivalent is the gate tooling itself driven through the compiled binary. Observed this session against a freshly compiled /tmp/forge-m14-04-accept: (1) `forge gate baseline` -> exit 0 (active schema_version 1, baseline_version 1, doc docs/engineering/ENGINEERING_BASELINE.md); (2) `forge gate validate --manifest docs/reviews/m14/M14-03.manifest.json` -> exit 0 'OK: task M14-03 transition REVIEW_APPROVED -> ACCEPTED is legal under baseline v1'; (3) `forge gate next --manifest docs/reviews/m14/M14-03.manifest.json` -> exit 0 'OK: predecessor M14-03 is ACCEPTED; successor task may start'; (4) `forge gate validate --manifest docs/reviews/m14/M14-04.manifest.json` -> exit 0 (this manifest's REVIEW_APPROVED -> ACCEPTED transition is legal). The product-criteria evidence (AC1/AC2/AC3) is at unit + integration levels exercising the real internal/task.Compile compiler -> workgraph.Decompose composition (TestIntegration_CompileThenDecompose / TestIntegration_CompileVagueInputDecomposesSafely); the compiled-binary blackbox for the work-graph domain surface itself is deferred to FU-M14-04-3 when a CLI/daemon surface lands.

remediation_note: No remediation was required between REVIEW_APPROVED and ACCEPTED: the review returned REVIEW_APPROVED with zero BLOCKER and zero MAJOR findings (six MINOR follow-ups). The candidate production/test code at HEAD is byte-identical to the reviewed candidate 099bda3 (the only delta is docs/reviews/m14/M14-04_REVIEW.md). The acceptor created this manifest + docs/reviews/m14/M14-04_ACCEPTANCE.md to close MINOR-5 (FU-M14-04-R5: no manifest existed at review time). No production code was modified during acceptance; only acceptance artifacts were authored.
